verdict.rationale: Linear documents handing work to agents. Issues can be delegated to agents such as Copilot, Codex, Cursor, Devin and custom agents, with humans keeping ownership, and agents work in the same comments, projects and documents. Linear Agent can drive Claude Code and Codex, a delegated-issues view tracks each coding session, and an official MCP server lets external agents read the same workspace data. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of how context or session state is carried across a handoff between agents, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that context survives a handoff.
